previous_statement: Choose a basis of V adapted to the finite invariant filtration W_0 superset W_1 superset ... superset W_{k+1}=0. Because sigma^{*k} preserves each W_p, its matrix is block triangular with diagonal blocks representing the induced maps on W_p/W_{p+1}; therefore Tr(sigma^{*k}|V)=sum_{p=0}^k Tr(sigma^{*k}|W_p/W_{p+1}).
new_statement: Let T be an endomorphism of a finite-dimensional vector space V preserving a finite decreasing filtration W_0=V superset W_1 superset ... superset W_{k+1}=0. Choose a basis adapted to the filtration. The matrix of T is block triangular with diagonal blocks representing the induced maps T_p on W_p/W_{p+1}; since the trace of a block-triangular matrix is the sum of the traces of its diagonal blocks, Tr(T|V)=sum_{p=0}^k Tr(T_p|W_p/W_{p+1}).
